text: How does the labview handle the error when the code executes?
options: The  VI  executes  without  error  because  the  missing  file  is  created  by open/create/replace file
Labview    displays    the    error    handling    dialog    box    10    times    listing open/create/replace file as the source of the error
Labview displays the error handling dialog box 10 times listing close file as the source of the error
Labview displays the error handling dialog box 9 times listing close file as the source of the error
